sources.title: Clave readme
sources.locator: Download; Windows early; Agent plugin; Features; Requirements; License
sources.finding: Documents parallel agent PTYs, Mac and early Windows installers, local/SSH work, a separate server, a Git diff/commit panel and an agent plugin that writes workspace files.

sources.title: Clave src/shared/agent-launch.ts
sources.finding: The pinned source has built-in launch profiles for claude, agy, codex, pi and opencode, with distinct owned resume/session/permission flags.

sources.title: Clave docs/adr/0001-agent-launch-profiles-and-capabilities.md
sources.finding: Typed launch profiles retain wrapper argument arrays and agent-owned session/resume integration; Pi has explicitly scoped Mac capabilities.

sources.title: Clave docs/server-install.md
sources.locator: Opening scope; Before you start; Install; options
sources.finding: A user-installed daemon owns sessions/history on Linux or macOS and continues after the Mac disconnects. It uses a private bearer-token HTTP endpoint over Tailscale/SSH, available from3.0.0-beta.6.

sources.title: Clave src/renderer/src/components/git/GitDiffPreview.tsx
sources.locator: GitDiffPreview; diff request and DiffLinesView content rendering
sources.finding: The Git diff preview opens changed file content and renders actual parsed patch rows, not only a diffstat/file list.

sources.title: Clave src/renderer/src/components/git/DiffLinesView.tsx
sources.finding: The line renderer displays line.content with add/delete/context prefixes and hunk-specific colors, as well as loading/error/no-change states.

sources.title: Clave docs/routines/README.md
sources.locator: Proposed example routine; runsOn; machine-owned routine creation
sources.finding: Documents workspace-file and machine-owned routines, cron configuration, explicit run location, per-machine stores and product routine-create/run tools.

sources.title: Clave src/main/routines/scheduler.ts
sources.locator: tick decision function and module header
sources.finding: This pure module decides run/skip/fail from due occurrences, catch-up and active-run inputs. Its header points to service.ts for the30-second tick and actual run start.

sources.title: Clave src/main/routines/launch.ts
sources.finding: The launch module resolves a routine into typed SpawnOptions using the same agent/profile/account rules as clave_open_session. Actual sessions.start happens in service.ts.

sources.title: Clave ROADMAP.md
sources.locator: Deferred: Agent tab status indicators for Antigravity
sources.finding: The official roadmap calls Antigravity tab status indicators deferred and undated; it does not commit a delivery date.

sources.title: Clave LICENSE
sources.finding: The main repository source has the MIT grant.

sources.title: Clave routine service
sources.locator: startRun lines442-527; tick lines617-650; service.start lines945-989
sources.finding: The service claims a due occurrence, calls startRun, resolves typed options and invokes options.sessions.start; its timer runs tick at the configured interval. Routine runs intentionally stop with the server rather than surviving in tmux.
